pitch_en: Research, consulting, training, and digital solutions for energy efficiency, decarbonization, and just energy transition across buildings, industry, and public policy.
pitch_es: Investigación, consultoría, formación y soluciones digitales para eficiencia energética, descarbonización y transición energética justa en edificios, industria y política pública.
cta_pitch_en: Certified B Corp focused on operational intelligence for energy performance and emissions reduction.
cta_pitch_es: B Corp certificada enfocada en inteligencia operacional para desempeño energético y reducción de emisiones.

sections.head_en: Energy-intensive assets lack actionable intelligence to cut costs, emissions, and compliance risk.
sections.head_es: Los activos intensivos en energía carecen de inteligencia accionable para reducir costos, emisiones y riesgo de cumplimiento.
sections.body_en: Companies and cities need scalable diagnostics, ESG-aligned consulting, and technology-based tools to drive just energy transition outcomes.
sections.body_es: Empresas y ciudades necesitan diagn´sticos escalables, consultoría alineada a ESG y herramientas tecnológicas para impulsar una transición energética justa.

steps.text_en: Energy efficiency, decarbonization, and ESG consulting plus training and digital solutions.
steps.text_es: Energy efficiency, decarbonization, and ESG consulting plus training and digital solutions.

steps.text_en: Headquarters in São Paulo with presence in Brazil and Canada (public site).
steps.text_es: Headquarters in São Paulo with presence in Brazil and Canada (public site).
